people.explanation: God formed the first man from the dust of the ground.
clues: I was the first man God made.
I was formed from the dust of the ground.
I was placed in the garden of Eden to tend it.
people.hint: My name means 'man' or 'earth'.

people.explanation: Adam named his wife Eve, the mother of all living.
clues: I was made from a rib taken from the man.
The serpent deceived me in the garden.
I was the first woman.
people.hint: My husband named me.

people.explanation: Abel was a keeper of sheep whose offering was accepted by God.
clues: I was the second son of Adam and Eve.
I kept sheep.
My brother Cain killed me.
people.hint: My brother was older.

people.explanation: Enoch walked with God, and God took him.
clues: I walked faithfully with God.
I was the father of Methuselah.
I did not die but was taken by God.
people.hint: My name is also a city in Cain's line.

people.explanation: Noah found grace with God and built the ark.
clues: I built a large ark on God's instructions.
I was saved with my family from the flood.
After the flood I offered sacrifice to God.
people.hint: A rainbow is God's sign to me.

people.explanation: God called Abram from Ur and promised to make him a great nation.
clues: I was called out of Ur of the Chaldees.
God made a covenant of descendants as many as the stars.
I was willing to offer my son Isaac.
people.hint: My name means 'father of many'.

people.explanation: God gave Sarah a new name and promised she would be a mother of nations.
clues: I laughed when I heard I would have a son in old age.
I was the wife of Abraham.
I was the mother of Isaac.
people.hint: My name was changed by God.

people.explanation: Isaac was the son of promise, born to Abraham and Sarah.
clues: I was the son of promise.
My name means 'laughter'.
My father nearly offered me on Mount Moriah.
people.hint: I married Rebekah.

people.explanation: Rebekah was chosen as Isaac's wife after showing kindness at the well.
clues: I offered water to a stranger and his camels at a well.
I was the wife of Isaac.
I was the mother of Jacob and Esau.
people.hint: I came from Nahor's family.

people.explanation: Jacob wrestled with God and received the name Israel.
clues: I bought my brother's birthright for a meal.
I wrestled with a man until the break of day.
My twelve sons became the tribes of Israel.
people.hint: I was renamed Israel.

people.explanation: Esau sold his birthright to his brother for food.
clues: I was a skilful hunter.
I sold my birthright for a bowl of stew.
I was the twin brother of Jacob.
people.hint: My name is linked to a people called Edom.

people.explanation: Joseph was sold by his brothers, rose to power in Egypt and forgave them.
clues: I wore a coat of many colours.
I interpreted dreams in prison and then in Pharaoh's court.
I forgave the brothers who sold me into Egypt.
people.hint: I was the son of Jacob and Rachel.

people.explanation: God called Moses from the burning bush to lead Israel out of Egypt.
clues: I was found in the reeds of the Nile as a baby.
I received the law on Mount Sinai.
I led Israel out of Egypt.
people.hint: My brother was Aaron.

people.explanation: Aaron served as Moses' spokesman and became the first high priest.
clues: I spoke on behalf of my brother before Pharaoh.
I made the golden calf when the people asked.
I became Israel's first high priest.
people.hint: I was the older brother of Moses.

people.explanation: Miriam led the women in song after the crossing of the Red Sea.
clues: I watched over my baby brother in the river.
I was a prophetess.
I led the women in singing after the Red Sea crossing.
people.hint: I was the sister of Moses.

people.explanation: Joshua succeeded Moses and led Israel into the promised land.
clues: I was Moses' assistant.
I was one of the twelve spies who trusted God.
I led Israel across the Jordan into Canaan.
people.hint: I was the son of Nun.

people.explanation: Caleb trusted God to take the land and was given Hebron.
clues: I was one of the twelve spies who believed God would give the land.
I was loyal alongside Joshua.
I received Hebron as my inheritance.
people.hint: I wholly followed the LORD.

people.explanation: Rahab hid the spies in Jericho and was saved when the walls fell.
clues: I lived in a house built into the city wall of Jericho.
I hid two spies on my roof.
I and my family were spared when Jericho fell.
people.hint: I was a woman of faith, named in Hebrews.

people.explanation: God reduced Gideon's army so that the victory would clearly be His.
clues: I threshed wheat in a winepress to hide from enemies.
I asked for a fleece as a sign.
I defeated Midian with just three hundred men.
people.hint: I was a judge of Israel.

people.explanation: Deborah judged Israel and encouraged Barak to fight.
clues: I was a prophetess who judged Israel.
I sat under a palm tree to give judgment.
I sang a song of victory with Barak.
people.hint: I was a woman leader in a time of trouble.

people.explanation: Samson's great strength was linked to his Nazirite vow.
clues: My strength was linked to a vow of separation.
I was betrayed by Delilah.
I pulled down a temple on the Philistines.
people.hint: My hair was never cut.

people.explanation: Ruth's loyalty to Naomi led her to Bethlehem and into the line of David.
clues: I was a Moabite who stayed with my mother-in-law.
I gleaned in the fields of Boaz.
I became the great-grandmother of King David.
people.hint: A book bears my name.

people.explanation: Naomi returned to Bethlehem after losing her husband and sons.
clues: I lost my husband and both my sons in Moab.
I returned to Bethlehem with my daughter-in-law.
I arranged for Ruth to meet Boaz.
people.hint: My name means 'pleasant'.

people.explanation: Boaz, a kinsman, showed kindness to Ruth in his fields.
clues: I was a wealthy relative of Naomi.
I let Ruth glean in my fields.
I married Ruth.
people.hint: I was a redeemer of the family.

people.explanation: Hannah prayed at Shiloh for a son and gave Samuel to the Lord.
clues: I prayed for a child at the tabernacle.
I dedicated my son to serve the LORD.
I sang a song of thanks after Samuel was born.
people.hint: I was the mother of Samuel.

people.explanation: Samuel heard God's voice as a boy and became a prophet.
clues: I heard God call my name in the night.
I was raised in the house of Eli.
I anointed the first two kings of Israel.
people.hint: My mother was Hannah.

people.explanation: Saul was chosen as the first king of Israel, but later disobeyed God.
clues: I was taller than anyone in Israel.
I was anointed as the first king.
I disobeyed God and lost my kingdom.
people.hint: Later Paul had a similar name.

people.explanation: Jonathan loved David as his own soul and made a covenant with him.
clues: I was the son of King Saul.
I made a covenant of friendship with David.
I shot arrows to warn David of Saul's plan.
people.hint: I was the closest friend of David.

people.explanation: Abigail acted wisely to prevent David from taking revenge on her household.
clues: I was wise and beautiful.
I was married to the foolish Nabal.
I went out with food to meet David and stopped him from bloodshed.
people.hint: I later married David.

people.explanation: Nathan the prophet confronted David about his sin with Bathsheba.
clues: I was a prophet in King David's court.
I told David a story about a poor man's lamb.
I said to David, 'Thou art the man.'
people.hint: I was bold to speak truth to a king.

people.explanation: Bathsheba was the wife of Uriah and later the mother of Solomon.
clues: I was seen bathing by King David.
I was the wife of Uriah the Hittite.
I was the mother of King Solomon.
people.hint: I was married to David after a tragic event.

people.explanation: Absalom plotted to take the throne from his father David.
clues: I was the handsome son of King David.
I stole the hearts of Israel's men.
I was killed when my hair caught in a tree.
people.hint: I was David's third son.

people.explanation: Elijah challenged the prophets of Baal on Mount Carmel.
clues: I challenged the prophets of Baal on Mount Carmel.
Fire fell from heaven when I prayed.
I was taken to heaven in a whirlwind.
people.hint: Ravens fed me by the brook Cherith.

people.explanation: Elisha received a double portion of the spirit of Elijah.
clues: I received a double portion of the spirit of my master.
I performed many miracles, including healing Naaman.
I was the successor of Elijah.
people.hint: I was ploughing when I was called.

people.explanation: Naaman, a Syrian commander, was healed of leprosy after bathing in the Jordan.
clues: I was a commander in the Syrian army.
I suffered from leprosy.
I was healed after washing seven times in the Jordan.
people.hint: A young servant girl told me about the prophet.

people.explanation: Hezekiah trusted the LORD and was granted fifteen more years of life.
clues: I was a king of Judah who trusted the LORD.
I removed the high places and the bronze serpent Nehushtan.
I prayed when I was sick and God added years to my life.
people.hint: I was a son of Ahaz.

people.explanation: Josiah led a reform after the book of the law was found in the temple.
clues: I became king of Judah at the age of eight.
I led a reform after the book of the law was found.
I renewed the covenant with the LORD.
people.hint: I was a great reforming king.

people.explanation: Isaiah saw the Lord high and lifted up and answered the call, 'Here am I'.
clues: I saw the Lord high and lifted up in a vision.
I said, 'Here am I; send me.'
I prophesied about the coming Servant.
people.hint: A prophetic book bears my name.

people.explanation: Jeremiah was called as a prophet while still young.
clues: I was called to be a prophet while still young.
I was known as the weeping prophet.
I was thrown into a cistern by my enemies.
people.hint: I wrote the Lamentations.

people.explanation: Ezekiel received visions by the river Chebar while in exile.
clues: I was a priest who prophesied in exile.
I saw a vision of wheels within wheels.
I saw a valley of dry bones come to life.
people.hint: I was a prophet by the river Chebar.

people.explanation: Daniel refused the king's food and prayed three times a day.
clues: I refused the king's rich food and wine.
I kept praying toward Jerusalem despite a decree.
I interpreted dreams in Babylon.
people.hint: I was a young Hebrew exile.

people.explanation: Shadrach and his friends refused to bow to the golden image and were kept safe in the furnace.
clues: I refused to bow to the golden image.
I was thrown into a furnace.
A fourth figure walked with me in the fire.
people.hint: I was one of three friends with Daniel.

people.explanation: Meshach was among the three friends who survived the blazing furnace.
clues: I was thrown into the fiery furnace with two friends.
The fire did not harm me.
The king saw a fourth man in the fire.
people.hint: I was one of Daniel's three companions.

people.explanation: Abednego trusted God even if God did not deliver him.
clues: I answered the king that God could deliver us.
I was thrown into the furnace.
I walked unharmed in the fire.
people.hint: I was one of Daniel's three companions.

people.explanation: Nebuchadnezzar was humbled and acknowledged God as the Most High.
clues: I was the great king of Babylon.
I built an image of gold on the plain of Dura.
I was humbled and lived like an animal for a time.
people.hint: I destroyed Jerusalem.

people.explanation: Job was blameless and upright, and remained faithful through great suffering.
clues: I was blameless and upright.
I lost my children, property and health.
God restored my family and possessions twofold.
people.hint: I lived in the land of Uz.

people.explanation: Obadiah protected a hundred prophets from Jezebel.
clues: I was the governor of King Ahab's house.
I hid one hundred prophets in caves.
I feared the LORD greatly.
people.hint: I was not the same as the prophet who wrote a short book.

people.explanation: Jonah was sent to Nineveh, but first ran away from God's call.
clues: I tried to flee to Tarshish from God.
I was swallowed by a great fish.
I preached to Nineveh, which repented.
people.hint: I sat under a gourd vine.

people.explanation: Ezra was a scribe who set his heart to study and teach the law.
clues: I was a priest and scribe skilled in the law of Moses.
I brought a group back from Babylon.
I read the law to the people at Jerusalem.
people.hint: I set my heart to seek the law.

people.explanation: Nehemiah prayed, then asked the king to rebuild Jerusalem's walls.
clues: I was the king's cupbearer.
I prayed and wept over Jerusalem's broken walls.
I led the rebuilding of the walls.
people.hint: I was an exile who served Artaxerxes.

people.explanation: Mordecai raised Esther and urged her to act for her people.
clues: I raised my cousin Esther after her parents died.
I sat at the king's gate.
I urged Esther to speak to the king for her people.
people.hint: I was the cousin of Esther.

people.explanation: Esther risked her life to speak to the king for the Jews.
clues: I became queen of Persia.
I fasted for three days before approaching the king.
I saved my people from destruction.
people.hint: I was once known as Hadassah.

people.explanation: Mary responded in faith to the angel's announcement of Jesus' birth.
clues: An angel announced that I would bear the Son of the Highest.
I said, 'Be it unto me according to thy word.'
I stood at the cross.
people.hint: I lived in Nazareth.

people.explanation: Elizabeth was the mother of John the Baptist and a relative of Mary.
clues: I was the wife of a priest named Zacharias.
I was barren but bore a child in old age.
I was the mother of John the Baptist.
people.hint: I was a cousin of Mary.

people.explanation: Zacharias was made mute until the birth of his son John.
clues: I was a priest serving in the temple.
An angel told me I would have a son.
I could not speak until my son was named.
people.hint: I was the husband of Elizabeth.

people.explanation: John prepared the way for Jesus by preaching repentance in the wilderness.
clues: I wore clothing of camel's hair.
I baptised people in the Jordan.
I prepared the way for the Messiah.
people.hint: I was the cousin of Jesus.

people.explanation: Simeon waited for the consolation of Israel and saw the infant Jesus.
clues: I was righteous and waited for the consolation of Israel.
The Holy Spirit revealed I would not die before seeing the Christ.
I held the infant Jesus in the temple.
people.hint: I blessed the child in the temple.

people.explanation: Anna, a prophetess, spoke of the child to those who waited for redemption.
clues: I was a prophetess of great age.
I never left the temple, worshipping night and day.
I spoke of the child to all who looked for redemption.
people.hint: I was a widow for many years.

people.explanation: Andrew brought his brother Simon Peter to Jesus.
clues: I was a fisherman from Bethsaida.
I first followed John the Baptist.
I brought my brother to Jesus.
people.hint: My brother was Simon Peter.

people.explanation: Philip invited Nathanael to come and see Jesus.
clues: I came from Bethsaida.
I told Nathanael to come and see.
I asked Jesus to show us the Father.
people.hint: I was one of the twelve apostles.

people.explanation: Jesus described Nathanael as an Israelite in whom there is no guile.
clues: Jesus called me an Israelite indeed, without guile.
I was brought to Jesus by my friend Philip.
I doubted that anything good could come from Nazareth.
people.hint: I was sitting under a fig tree.

people.explanation: Thomas doubted until he saw the risen Lord, then confessed him.
clues: I was called Didymus, the Twin.
I doubted until I saw the wounds.
I cried, 'My Lord and my God.'
people.hint: I was one of the twelve.

people.explanation: Matthew, a tax collector, left his booth to follow Jesus.
clues: I collected taxes before following Jesus.
I was called from my tax booth.
I wrote the first Gospel.
people.hint: I was also named Levi.

people.explanation: Martha welcomed Jesus into her home, but was busy with many things.
clues: I welcomed Jesus into my home in Bethany.
I was busy serving while my sister sat at Jesus' feet.
Jesus raised my brother Lazarus.
people.hint: My sister was Mary.

people.explanation: Jesus raised Lazarus from the tomb after four days.
clues: I was the brother of Mary and Martha.
I was raised from the dead after four days in the tomb.
Jesus wept at my tomb.
people.hint: Jesus called me out of the grave.

people.explanation: Mary Magdalene was healed by Jesus and was the first to see the risen Lord.
clues: Jesus had cast seven devils out of me.
I stood by the cross and went to the tomb.
I was the first to see the risen Lord.
people.hint: I came from the town of Magdala.

people.explanation: Nicodemus came to Jesus by night and heard about being born again.
clues: I was a ruler of the Jews who came to Jesus at night.
I was told I must be born again.
I helped prepare Jesus' body for burial.
people.hint: I was a Pharisee.

people.explanation: Stephen was the first martyr of the church.
clues: I was full of faith and power and did great wonders.
I preached before the council and was stoned.
I prayed for those who stoned me.
people.hint: I was one of the first deacons.

people.explanation: Barnabas encouraged the new believers and supported Paul.
clues: My name means 'son of encouragement'.
I sold a field and gave the money to the apostles.
I travelled with Paul on his first journey.
people.hint: I came from Cyprus.

people.explanation: Silas sang with Paul in prison and saw the jailer converted.
clues: I was a leader among the Jerusalem believers.
I was imprisoned with Paul in Philippi.
I sang praises at midnight with Paul.
people.hint: I travelled with Paul on his second journey.

people.explanation: Timothy learned the Scriptures from childhood under his mother and grandmother.
clues: I learned the Holy Scriptures from childhood.
My mother and grandmother had faith before me.
Paul wrote two letters to me.
people.hint: I was a young pastor.

people.explanation: Luke was a physician and companion of Paul who wrote Luke and Acts.
clues: I was a physician.
I travelled with Paul.
I wrote the Gospel and the book of Acts.
people.hint: I am called the beloved physician.

people.explanation: Cornelius was a devout centurion whose household received the Holy Spirit.
clues: I was a centurion of the Italian band.
I was a devout man who feared God and gave alms.
God sent an angel to tell me to call for Peter.
people.hint: I lived in Caesarea.

people.explanation: Lydia, a seller of purple, opened her heart to Paul's message and hosted the church.
clues: I was a seller of purple from Thyatira.
The Lord opened my heart to listen to Paul.
I invited Paul and his companions into my home.
people.hint: I was a businesswoman in Philippi.

people.explanation: Priscilla and Aquila were tentmakers who hosted churches and taught Apollos.
clues: I was a tentmaker with my husband.
I taught Apollos more accurately about the way of God.
I risked my life for Paul.
people.hint: My husband is Aquila.

people.explanation: Apollos was an eloquent man mighty in the Scriptures, taught more fully by Priscilla and Aquila.
clues: I was an eloquent man from Alexandria.
I was mighty in the Scriptures.
I was taught more perfectly by Priscilla and Aquila.
people.hint: I later preached in Corinth.

people.explanation: Epaphroditus risked his life to bring Paul gifts while Paul was in prison.
clues: I was a fellow worker and soldier with Paul.
I was sick and nearly died for the work of Christ.
I carried the church's gift to Paul in prison.
people.hint: I was sent by the church at Philippi.

people.explanation: Onesimus became a brother in Christ through Paul's ministry.
clues: I once ran away from my master.
Paul wrote a letter asking that I be received as a brother.
I was once unprofitable but became profitable.
people.hint: The letter to Philemon concerns me.

people.explanation: Dorcas was full of good works and was raised from the dead by Peter.
clues: I was full of good works and alms deeds.
I made coats and garments for widows.
Peter raised me from the dead.
people.hint: My Greek name means 'gazelle'.

people.explanation: Gamaliel advised the council not to oppose the apostles, in case they were of God.
clues: I was a respected teacher of the law.
I advised the council to leave the apostles alone.
I was the teacher of Paul.
people.hint: I was a Pharisee.

people.explanation: Herod was a king who feared a rival and ordered the killing of infants in Bethlehem.
clues: I was king when Jesus was born.
I asked the wise men to report back to me.
I ordered the children in Bethlehem to be killed.
people.hint: I was a ruler over Judea.

people.explanation: Pilate, the Roman governor, questioned Jesus and handed him over for crucifixion.
clues: I was the Roman governor of Judea.
I asked Jesus, 'What is truth?'
I washed my hands before the crowd.
people.hint: I was the governor who judged Jesus.

people.explanation: Caiaphas, the high priest, said it was expedient that one man should die.
clues: I was the high priest that year.
I advised that one man die for the people.
I questioned Jesus at night before the council.
people.hint: I was the high priest with Annas.

people.explanation: Judas, one of the twelve, betrayed Jesus for thirty pieces of silver.
clues: I was one of the twelve.
I received thirty pieces of silver.
I betrayed my Master with a kiss.
people.hint: I was the keeper of the money bag.

people.explanation: Cain killed his brother Abel and was marked by God.
clues: I was the firstborn son of Adam and Eve.
I was a farmer.
I killed my brother out of jealousy.
people.hint: God marked me so I would not be killed.

people.explanation: Methuselah was the oldest man recorded in Scripture.
clues: I was the son of Enoch.
I lived longer than any other man in the record.
I lived 969 years.
people.hint: My name is famously linked to great age.

people.explanation: Lot escaped Sodom, though his wife looked back and became a pillar of salt.
clues: I was the nephew of Abraham.
I lived in Sodom.
My wife looked back when we fled the city.
people.hint: I was rescued from the destruction of two cities.

people.explanation: Balaam's donkey spoke to him when he was blind to the angel on the road.
clues: I was a prophet hired to curse Israel.
My donkey spoke to me.
An angel stood in my path with a drawn sword.
people.hint: I rode a donkey.

people.explanation: Phinehas turned God's wrath from Israel and received a covenant of peace.
clues: I was a grandson of Aaron.
I stopped a plague by zeal for the LORD.
I received a covenant of peace.
people.hint: I was a priest.

people.explanation: Achan took forbidden spoil from Jericho and brought trouble on Israel.
clues: I took a garment, silver and gold from Jericho that was forbidden.
My sin brought defeat at Ai.
I was stoned in the valley of Achor.
people.hint: I was from the tribe of Judah.

people.explanation: Eli was a priest who trained Samuel but failed to restrain his sons.
clues: I was the high priest at Shiloh.
I taught the boy Samuel to answer God.
I failed to restrain my wicked sons.
people.hint: I was an old priest.

people.explanation: Goliath was a Philistine champion defeated by David's trust in God.
clues: I was a giant from Gath.
I defied the armies of Israel for forty days.
I was struck down by a stone from a sling.
people.hint: I was a Philistine.

people.explanation: Bezalel was filled with the Spirit of God to craft the tabernacle furnishings.
clues: I was filled with the Spirit of God.
I was skilled in every kind of craftsmanship.
I built the tabernacle and its furnishings.
people.hint: I was a craftsman from the tribe of Judah.

people.explanation: Hur helped hold up Moses' hands during the battle against Amalek.
clues: I stood beside Moses during a battle.
I held up Moses' hands with Aaron.
I was a leader in Israel.
people.hint: I was a companion of Aaron.

people.explanation: Keturah became Abraham's wife after Sarah died.
clues: I became Abraham's wife after Sarah.
I bore him several sons.
I am mentioned in Genesis after Isaac.
people.hint: I was a wife of Abraham.

people.explanation: Hagar was an Egyptian servant who met God in the wilderness.
clues: I was an Egyptian servant.
I fled into the wilderness and God saw me.
I bore a son named Ishmael.
people.hint: I named God 'the God who sees me'.

people.explanation: God heard Ishmael's cry in the wilderness and made him a great nation.
clues: I was the son of Hagar and Abraham.
God heard my cry in the wilderness.
God promised to make a great nation of me.
people.hint: I was the first son of Abraham.

people.explanation: Laban deceived Jacob by giving him Leah instead of Rachel.
clues: I was the uncle of Jacob.
I gave Leah to Jacob instead of Rachel.
I made Jacob work many years for my daughters.
people.hint: I was the father of Rachel and Leah.

people.explanation: Rachel was the beloved wife of Jacob, mother of Joseph and Benjamin.
clues: I was the beloved wife of Jacob.
I was barren for a long time before I bore a son.
I was the mother of Joseph and Benjamin.
people.hint: I died giving birth to Benjamin.

people.explanation: Dinah was the daughter of Jacob and Leah whose story led to conflict.
clues: I was the daughter of Jacob and Leah.
I was defiled by a man of Shechem.
My brothers avenged me.
people.hint: I was the only daughter of Jacob named in Genesis.

people.explanation: Potiphar's wife falsely accused Joseph when he refused her advances.
clues: I was the wife of an officer in Pharaoh's household.
I tried to seduce Joseph.
I falsely accused Joseph to my husband.
people.hint: My husband was Potiphar.

people.explanation: Pharaoh's daughter drew Moses from the river and raised him as her son.
clues: I found a basket in the reeds of the Nile.
I had compassion on a Hebrew child.
I raised the child as my son.
people.hint: I was a princess of Egypt.

people.explanation: Zipporah was Moses' wife and circumcised their son in a moment of danger.
clues: I was the daughter of a Midianite priest.
I married Moses.
I circumcised my son to save my husband's life.
people.hint: My father was Jethro.

people.explanation: Jethro advised Moses to share the work of judging the people.
clues: I was a priest of Midian.
I was the father-in-law of Moses.
I advised Moses to appoint judges over the people.
people.hint: I am also called Reuel.

people.explanation: Korah rebelled against Moses and Aaron and was swallowed by the earth.
clues: I led a rebellion against Moses and Aaron.
I said the whole congregation was holy.
The earth opened and swallowed me.
people.hint: I was a Levite.

people.explanation: Og, king of Bashan, was defeated by Israel and his iron bed remained as a memorial.
clues: I was the king of Bashan.
I was a giant whose iron bed remained.
Israel defeated me in battle.
people.hint: I was defeated by Moses.

people.explanation: Sihon, king of the Amorites, refused passage to Israel and was defeated.
clues: I was the king of the Amorites.
I refused Israel passage through my land.
Israel defeated me at Jahaz.
people.hint: I ruled east of the Jordan.

people.explanation: Gehazi, Elisha's servant, lied to gain Naaman's gifts and was struck with leprosy.
clues: I was the servant of Elisha.
I lied to Naaman to gain his gifts.
I was struck with leprosy as a result.
people.hint: I was the servant of a prophet who healed Naaman.

people.explanation: Peter denied Jesus three times, then was restored and led the early church.
clues: I was a fisherman called by Jesus from the lake.
I denied knowing Jesus three times before the cock crowed.
I was restored by Jesus and fed his sheep.
people.hint: My brother was Andrew.

people.explanation: Paul's encounter with Jesus on the road to Damascus changed his life.
clues: I once persecuted the church before my conversion.
I was a tentmaker who travelled to many cities.
I wrote many letters that are now part of the New Testament.
people.hint: I was born in Tarsus.

people.explanation: John does not give her name; her testimony led others to meet Jesus.
clues: I met Jesus at a well in Samaria.
I had been married several times.
I told my town about the man who knew everything I did.
people.hint: The conversation happened at Jacob's well.
